card.name: The digit 5 ending 0.25 amounts
card.fires_on: The digit 5 right after "0.2" in a decimal number, making 0.25 (also 20.25). It shows up in dose amounts and tables, usually before a unit like mg, mL, mcg or ng/kg.

modes.label: 0.25 before a unit
modes.description: The final 5 of 0.25 followed by a measure such as mg, mL or mcg.

modes.label: 0.25 in number tables
modes.description: The 5 of 0.25 inside a list or table of numbers.

card.plain: It lights up on the last digit of the number 0.25 when it appears as an amount in dosing text.
